Image1.ExpectedText: GLM-OCR supports standard text, formula, and table recognition prompts, alongside custom JSON schemas for structured information extraction. Supported Prompt Types Text Recognition: Use "Text Recognition:" to extract raw or dense text content in plain text format.Formula Recognition: Use "Formula Recognition:" to steer the model into converting mathematical expressions into LaTeX.Table Recognition: Use "Table Recognition:" to recover table structures and align rows/columns into Markdown or HTML sequences.Information Extraction (JSON): Provide a strict, custom JSON schema prompt (e.g., 请按下列JSON格式输出图中信息: {...}) to extract specific key-value pairs from IDs, receipts, or forms.
